text: The Goa Investment Promotion and Facilitation of Single Window Clearance Act, 2021 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 202119 Act Number: 19 Enactment Date: 2021-07-30 Act Year: 2021 Short Title: The Goa Investment Promotion and Facilitation of Single Window Clearance Act, 2021 Long Title: To provide for the promotion of investment in the State of Goa and the creation of the administrative and operational framework for the Goa Investment Promotion and Facilitation Board as a single window clearance facilitation mechanism with the prime objective of ensuring time bound grant of various clearances, licenses, permissions and approvals under relevant State laws so as to provide an investor friendly environment in the State of Goa and for the matters connected therewith and incidental thereto.
